Contact
Cheam Fitness & Wellbeing Gym
Peaches Close , (off Sandy Lane) , Cheam , SM2 7BJ
020 8770 7858
You can find us just a 5-minute walk from Cheam Train Station or a 6-minute drive from Ewell East Station. Our gym is easily accessible from Cheam Town Centre or for anybody who lives in Belmont, Ewell or Stoneleigh. On-site free for 3 hours.
Opening times: Monday–Thursday : 06:30–22:00;
Friday : 06:30–21:30;
Weekends : 08:00–20:00;
Off peak hours : Weekdays: 09:00-17:00, Weekends: Anytime;
Bank Holiday hours : 08:00–20:00
Last entry: 60 minutes prior to closing time. Poolside and facilities close 30 minutes prior to closing. Gym facilities close 15 minutes prior to closing.
Membership plans
Choose the membership that best fits your lifestyle and goals. All plans include full access to the gym floor, swimming pool, sauna and steam room, plus unlimited fitness classes.
